title: Shift Intent Left: Intent Contract schema, validator, and reference enforcement point
description:
Reference artifacts for Shift Intent Left (SIL), a lifecycle discipline that treats the intent declared for an autonomous coding agent as the earliest securable artifact of the software development lifecycle.

Includes a JSON Schema for the Intent Contract, a validator enforcing four invariants that JSON Schema cannot express, and a reference enforcement point implementing the admissibility predicate, the severity-weighted Intent Drift metric, and a tamper-evident action trace.

This software supplements the preprint: 10.5281/zenodo.22855795.
